description: PRO — Adopt a ruleset on a legacy API without a wall of red: snapshot today's violations as a baseline, then pass that baseline back to fail only on NEW violations (with fixed counts, a warning budget and burndown).

context.description: Optional: why you are asking. One sentence — the task you are trying to complete, or what you expect to get back. Never included in the answer and never used to rank; it is read only when a result turns out to be wrong, which is when knowing the intent is what makes the report actionable.

document.description: The API description to operate on — OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, Arazzo or JSON Schema. A YAML/JSON string or an already-parsed object; both are accepted.

name: baseline_violations
